name: Csöde (Hungary)
description: A vertical light grey banner charged near the top with the municipal arms of Csöde: a crowned blue shield with a white figure holding a sabre on a green mound, above a scroll inscribed CSÖDE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Csöde arms with crown and scroll
